name: o9357

resource.description: The resource topic by which the HTML content is identified.

attribute.description: The attribute path within the resource that leads to the (i18n) HTML content.

i18n.description: Which locale to use for displaying this widget.

locale.description: The topic under which to expect the locale for this widget.

description: Please configure the widget to load its HTML content from the **topics/html/home** resource, using the **body.main** attribute as the entry point for the markup. The display language should be set to the **en-US** locale. This will ensure the home page renders correctly for English‑US users.
